title: Mars Colony Immune System
claim: A deterministic content-addressed frame chain can bound colony healing to observed delta, converge, preserve authority through precommitted logical-beat leases without election, and safely reattach an offline dimension only when its base claims do not contradict accepted history.
invariants: Every frame is canonicalized with lexicographically sorted object keys, hashed with browser Web Crypto SHA-256, and linked to the previous hash in its dimension.
All visible colony state is reconstructed by replaying accepted frames.
Every scan response references the exact parent scan-tile hash and every report references its response hashes.
Repair targets must equal the deterministic report delta; a full-colony sweep is rejected.
Coordinator succession follows a precommitted ranked roster and logical-beat lease windows without an election.
Offline research work reattaches only when exact base-claim comparison finds no contradiction.
positive_path: Inject the seeded synthetic drift into oxygen, water, and agriculture.
Fan one scan tile to all twelve modules and derive a linked deterministic report.
Repair only the three-module report delta and rescan those modules to an empty delta.
Disable ARES, advance to logical beat 4, and accept PHOBOS under the precommitted lease roster.
Partition research, append an observation to its offline dimension, and reattach its head after contradiction-free comparison.
failure_path: Attempt a twelve-module full sweep against a three-module report delta and fail the delta assertion.
Attempt a premature DEIMOS lower-rank claim and fail the logical-beat lease oracle.
Offer a contradictory navigation base claim during research reattachment and refuse the reattachment without mutating accepted colony state.
